parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of the coffeemachine, typically made of durable plastic. It covers the water reservoir or coffee bean compartment.
parts.Functional_description: The lid prevents dust and debris from entering the machine and helps maintain internal pressure and temperature during brewing.
parts.Movement_description: It can be opened or closed manually, usually hinged or detachable for refilling water or coffee beans.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the coffeemachine, made of stainless steel for durability and heat resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal components such as the heating element, pump, and control system, providing structural support and protection.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the fixed frame for all other parts.
